summary: Animated electric, flame or fluid glow around a UI element's edge, with an optional chase.
overview: An elaborate animated edge glow for item frames, achievement icons and rarity borders — deliberately a separate tool from the lighting effect's Rim mode, which stays the cheap static edge light for ordinary buttons and panels.
Pattern decides what the mask looks like; Chase is an orthogonal toggle that sends comets travelling the perimeter, and can be combined with any pattern.
useCases: Drawing attention to an achievement or reward.
A charged or powered-up state on a UI element.

params.tuning: The big choice: what the mask actually looks like. Each pattern computes its mask differently rather than just tinting the same shape.
Orthogonal to pattern — you can chase any of them. It is not a pattern of its own.
Comets travelling at once, evenly spaced. More than three or four reads as a solid moving band rather than distinct comets.
A debugging aid as much as a look: it shows the noise mask directly, which is how the Electric pattern's real bug was originally found.
Multiples of Edge Width. Large values soften the effect into a haze and stop reading as an edge.
Leave empty to auto-generate a turbulent mask, which is tuned for these patterns.

gotchas.title: It has a lot of settings, most pattern-specific
gotchas.body: The Electric, Flame and Fluid groups only affect their own pattern. Changing a flame setting while on Electric does nothing.

gotchas.title: It instances the material
gotchas.body: Each component gets its own material instance so settings do not bleed between elements. That is correct and means more draw calls with many of them on screen.
